title: Refund Debit and Chargeback Terms of the Northloop Payments Plans
content:
Each Northloop Payments payout plan sets where seller-funded buyer refunds are debited and the terms on which card chargebacks are debited, charged, disputed and reversed.

## Terms by plan

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Where seller-funded buyer refunds are debited | payments balance | payments balance | payments balance | payments balance | payments balance | payments balance |
| Chargeback debited only when the order's liability party is the seller | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| When a seller-liable chargeback is debited | on the chargeback notice | on the chargeback notice | on the chargeback notice | on the chargeback notice | on the chargeback notice | on the chargeback notice |
| Chargeback fee per seller-liable chargeback (USD) | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Chargeback fee returned when the seller wins the dispute | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Response days for dispute evidence (calendar days after the chargeback debit) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 10 | 14 |
| Maximum dispute submissions per chargeback case | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| When the debit of a won chargeback is reversed | on the issuer decision | on the issuer decision | on the issuer decision | on the issuer decision | on the issuer decision | on the issuer decision |

## Meaning of each term

- **Refund debit source** — where buyer refunds funded by the seller are debited: the payments balance, on every plan.
- **Liability follows the order** — whether a chargeback is debited to the seller only when the order's liability party is the seller; yes on every plan.
- **Debit timing** — when a seller-liable chargeback is debited: on the chargeback notice.
- **Chargeback fee** — the fee per seller-liable chargeback, USD.
- **Fee returned on a win** — whether the chargeback fee is returned when the seller wins the dispute; only Payments Enterprise returns it.
- **Response days** — the calendar days after the chargeback debit within which the seller may submit dispute evidence.
- **Disputes per case** — the maximum number of dispute submissions per chargeback case.
- **Win reversal timing** — when the debit of a won chargeback is reversed: on the issuer decision.

*Hypothetical reading.* A seller on Payments Daily Plus whose chargeback was debited on a given day may submit evidence within 10 calendar days after that debit date, once for that case; the fee charged on that chargeback is 15.00 USD and the plan does not return it on a win.
